scenario_title: GET /: public API documentation and catalog without device mutation
procedure: reset the simulator to the seed state
wait for the simulator Telnet link before setup and fault injection
let the hub read the matrix (/ws get_status), so it is in sync before the action

extended_status.GET /api/status/outputs: Detailed output status (connection detection, HDCP, HDR, etc.)

control.POST /api/switch: Route input to output (body: {input: N, output: N})

input_cycling.POST /api/input/next: Cycle to next input on output (query: ?output=1)
input_cycling.POST /api/input/previous: Cycle to previous input on output (query: ?output=1)
input_cycling.POST /api/output/{1-8}/source: Set source for specific output (body: {input: N})

edid_control.POST /api/input/{1-8}/edid: Set EDID mode for input (body: {mode: N})

profiles.POST /api/profile: Create profile (body: {id, name, outputs, icon?, macros?, power_on_macro?, power_off_macro?})
profiles.POST /api/profile/{id}/recall: Apply profile to matrix (runs power_on_macro if set)

websocket_events.connected: Sent on initial connection with client count
websocket_events.routing_change: Sent when input routing changes on an output
websocket_events.connection_change: Sent when display connection status changes
websocket_events.signal_change: Sent when input signal status changes
websocket_events.status_update: Full status response (on request or periodic)
